hook.name: PulseFeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad pool fee hook that deducts a fixed fee (creator tax plus 1% protocol fee) from the quote side of every swap, settled as ERC-6909 claims via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap return delta. Pool creation and coin fee registration are restricted to a factory address; the factory's own swaps can bypass fees by passing non-empty hookData.
